‘Fastgrow’ is an NPK fertiliser containing elements essential for improved plant growth.
Which mixture of substances is used to make ‘Fastgrow’?
A
ammonium sulfate and potassium nitrate
B
ammonium nitrate and potassium phosphate
C
sodium nitrate and ammonium phosphate
D
sodium phosphate and potassium chloride
subject: Chemistry
